senses.sense_definition: Een ruimte die specifiek is ingericht voor het houden van vergaderingen of conferenties.

examples.text: Iedereen verzamelt zich om tien uur in de grote <w>vergaderzaal</w> voor de presentatie.

target_lang_translations.en: Everyone is gathering at ten o'clock in the large <w>meeting room</w> for the presentation.

examples.text: De <w>vergaderzaal</w> is vandaag helaas al de hele dag bezet door een ander team.

target_lang_translations.en: Unfortunately, the <w>conference room</w> is occupied by another team all day today.

target_lang_definitions.en: A room specifically designed and equipped for holding meetings or conferences.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: The most common and general term for a room used for meetings.
Often implies a larger or more formal space for meetings.
Specifically a room for high-level meetings, usually with a large table.
